text: Natural Language Processing, or NLP, is a part of artificial intelligence that helps computers understand human language. One important use is text understanding, which allows machines to read and make sense of written words. NLP also powers translation tools that change text from one language to another, making communication across the world much easier. Another useful application is sentiment analysis, where computers study text to find out if people feel positive, negative, or neutral about something. Finally, chatbots use NLP to chat with people and answer questions in a natural way. Thanks to NLP, our daily digital experiences are becoming smarter and more helpful.
